semantics.behavior: Combinational incoming-call selection: when ring is asserted, vibrate_mode selects motor instead of ringer; when ring is deasserted both outputs are off.
semantics.cycle: No clock port or cycle delay is specified; outputs follow inputs combinationally.
semantics.reset: No reset port or reset behavior is specified.
semantics.initialization: No state or initial output values are specified; evaluate outputs after driven inputs settle.

numeric.width: All ports are one-bit logic signals.
numeric.arithmetic: Boolean selection only; no arithmetic or signedness.

verification.oracle: Explicit expected output pairs from the original incoming-call and mode requirements.
verification.coverage: Exercise all four binary input combinations and every ordered transition among combinations.
verification.sampling: Check one time unit after each input assignment for combinational settling, with no clock or reset.
verification.failure: Use fatal mismatches and bounded timeout; emit PASS only after all checks.

specification_ambiguities.resolution: Both outputs off when ring=0, as implied by controlling the ringer and motor for an incoming call.
Original requirements specify binary behavior only; no additional X/Z oracle is imposed.
